title: post api auth signup create new user account
description: Test POST /api/auth/signup with valid name, email, password. Expect 201 with JWT token and user object. Also test duplicate email returns 409 and missing fields return 400.

title: post api auth signin authenticate user
description: Test POST /api/auth/signin with valid credentials (email=test_pawal@yopmail.com, password=Wlink123). Expect 200 with JWT token and user object. Also test invalid password returns 401.

title: get api auth me return current user profile
description: Test GET /api/auth/me with valid Bearer JWT token. Expect 200 with user profile. Test missing Authorization header returns 401. Test invalid/malformed token returns 401.

title: post api auth forgot password send otp
description: Test POST /api/auth/forgot-password with known email. Expect 200. Test with unknown email also returns 200 (anti-enumeration). Test missing email returns 400 or 500.

title: post api auth verify otp validate otp
description: Test POST /api/auth/verify-otp with invalid OTP. Expect 400 invalid OTP. Cannot test valid OTP flow since OTP is sent via email.

title: post api auth reset password set new password
description: Test POST /api/auth/reset-password with invalid reset token. Expect 400 invalid or expired token. Cannot test valid flow since it depends on verify-otp.

title: post api contact messages submit public message
description: Test POST /api/contact-messages with valid name, email, message. Expect 200 with success:true. Test missing required fields returns 400.

title: post api contact messages reply send email reply
description: Test POST /api/contact-messages/reply requires auth. Without auth cookie expect 401. With auth cookie send messageId, subject, replyBody.

title: post api chat send save direct chat message
description: Test POST /api/chat/send requires auth. Without auth expect 401. With auth but missing content/conversationId expect 400.

title: get api stripe plan prices list plan price ids
description: Test GET /api/stripe/plan-prices. Expect 200 with an object mapping plan keys to Stripe price IDs.

title: get api plan limits check agency plan limits
description: Test GET /api/plan-limits with query params agencyId and type=subaccount. Expect 200 with allowed, currentCount, maxAllowed fields. Test missing agencyId returns 400.

title: get api media list media files
description: Test GET /api/media with valid subAccountId query param. Expect 200 with media array. Test missing subAccountId returns 400.

title: post api stripe cancel subscription unauthorized
description: Test POST /api/stripe/cancel-subscription without auth. Expect 401. Test with non-owner role expect 403.

title: post api stripe create subscription session validation
description: Test POST /api/stripe/create-subscription-session without auth. Expect 401. Test with auth but missing required fields (agencyId, priceId, successUrl, cancelUrl) expect 400.

title: post api stripe create checkout session validation
description: Test POST /api/stripe/create-checkout-session with missing required fields. Expect 400. Test with empty prices array.
